provider_query: The first YouTube video, Me at the zoo
answer:
**“Me at the zoo”** is the first video uploaded to YouTube. Co-founder **Jawed Karim** posted it on **April 23, 2005** (about 8:27 p.m. PDT) to the channel **jawed**.

Key facts:

1. **Length and content** — Roughly 18–19 seconds. Karim stands in front of elephants at the **San Diego Zoo** and says they have “really, really, really long trunks,” and that’s “pretty much all there is to say.” Filmed by his high-school friend **Yakov Lapitsky**. [[1]](https://archive.li/2025.07.15-111458/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Me_at_the_zoo) [[2]](https://youtube.fandom.com/wiki/Me_at_the_zoo) [[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw)

2. **Watch it** — Original upload: [youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw). Views are in the hundreds of millions (reports around 350–440+ million in 2025–2026). [[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jNQXAC9IVRw) [[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jawed_Karim)

3. **Why it matters** — Often called the first YouTube vlog and a milestone for easy browser video sharing. Co-founders Karim, Chad Hurley, and Steve Chen built YouTube so ordinary clips could be uploaded and played without clunky plugins. [[1]](https://archive.li/2025.07.15-111458/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Me_at_the_zoo) [[5]](https://www.tubefilter.com/2025/04/23/20-years-youtube-me-at-the-zoo-2005-jawed-karim/) [[6]](https://applescoop.org/story/history-of-youtube-me-at-the-zoo-to-tv-giant)

4. **Karim** — Born October 28, 1979, in East Germany; software engineer and PayPal alum who co-founded YouTube. “Me at the zoo” is essentially his only classic upload; the channel has millions of subscribers. He has used the description to comment on platform changes (e.g., Google+ comments, dislike counts). [[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jawed_Karim) [[7]](https://www.the-sun.com/tech/14087057/youtube-first-video-me-at-the-zoo-google-karim/) [[8]](https://www.star-telegram.com/entertainment/article315252892.html)

5. **Zoo note** — Filmed at the San Diego Zoo elephant area; the zoo later commented that it was honored the first YouTube video was shot there. [[2]](https://youtube.fandom.com/wiki/Me_at_the_zoo) [[5]](https://www.tubefilter.com/2025/04/23/20-years-youtube-me-at-the-zoo-2005-jawed-karim/)

6. **Context** — Domain registered February 2005; public launch followed later that year. Google acquired YouTube in 2006 for about $1.65 billion. [[6]](https://applescoop.org/story/history-of-youtube-me-at-the-zoo-to-tv-giant) [[9]](https://beebom.com/first-youtube-video-13-years-zoo/)

7. **Cultural status** — Cited by outlets as one of the most important online videos and a symbol of early user-generated YouTube, despite its plain, low-resolution style. [[1]](https://archive.li/2025.07.15-111458/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Me_at_the_zoo) [[5]](https://www.tubefilter.com/2025/04/23/20-years-youtube-me-at-the-zoo-2005-jawed-karim/)

8. **Further viewing** — EmpLemon’s “Me at the zoo | YouTube Geographic” covers the clip’s history and Karim’s background. [[10]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dcZY3yi8Xbw)
